mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.complaint_no, c.owner_id, o.owner_name, o.owner_phone, c.house_id, h.house_number, b.building_name, cm.community_name, c.type, c.title, c.content, c.contact_phone, c.status, c.reply_content, c.reply_time, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM complaint_suggestion c LEFT JOIN owner_info o ON c.owner_id = o.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN house_info h ON c.house_id = h.id AND h.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN building_info b ON h.building_id = b.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN community_info cm ON b.community_id = cm.id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{complaintId} AND c.is_deleted = 0
